questions.example: Does the price include freight to Taiwan?
questions.exampleZh: 這個價格有包含運到台灣的運費嗎？

questions.example: Please put no more than 40 cartons on each pallet.
questions.exampleZh: 每個棧板請不要放超過 40 箱。

questions.prompt: What is the minimum order ____ for this item?
questions.example: What is the minimum order quantity for this item?
questions.exampleZh: 這個品項的最低訂購數量是多少？

questions.example: We need to pay a 30% deposit before production starts.
questions.exampleZh: 開始生產前，我們需要先付 30% 的訂金。

questions.prompt: Please confirm ____ of the payment when you get it.
questions.example: Please confirm receipt of the payment when you get it.
questions.exampleZh: 收到款項後，請確認已收到。

questions.example: The packing list shows 12 cartons, but we only received 10.
questions.exampleZh: 裝箱單上寫 12 箱，但我們只收到 10 箱。

questions.prompt: Could you send us a ____ quotation with the new price?
questions.example: Could you send us a revised quotation with the new price?
questions.exampleZh: 可以寄給我們一份有新價格的修改版報價單嗎？

questions.prompt: 情境：Email 裡想請供應商告訴你新的交期，最自然的說法是？
options: Please advise the new delivery date.
You advise me new date please.
questions.example: The shipment is delayed. Please advise the new delivery date.
questions.exampleZh: 這批貨延遲了，請告知新的交貨日期。

questions.prompt: 情境：會議後寄信，想說「如同我們討論過的」，最自然的開頭是？
questions.example: As discussed in our meeting, we will place the order next week.
questions.exampleZh: 如同我們在會議中討論的，我們下週會下單。

questions.word: phrase:let me know if you have any questions
questions.prompt: 情境：Email 結尾想說「有任何問題請告訴我」，最自然的說法是？
options: Let me know if you have any questions.
You have question, let me know it.
questions.example: I attached the new schedule. Let me know if you have any questions.
questions.exampleZh: 我附上了新的時程表，有任何問題請告訴我。
questions.id: phrase:let me know if you have any questions
